verification_report.summary: All submitted statements and proofs pass the sequential audit, conditional solely on the exact finite-A_theta higher-moment estimate in item 3, separately audited in big_minimal_moments_01. The other supplied internal premises were used without strengthening. Radial smoothing, the uniform A_theta bound, moving integrals, and varying-exponential weak convergence are valid. Smoothed-measure compactness correctly obtains envelope-class membership from first moments, L1(nu) convergence from the conditional moment estimate and bounded truncations, capacity convergence from self-measure control, and raw weak convergence from separately verified raw sublevel tails. For arbitrary finite nonzero NPP measures, the carrier/CLN argument gives finite A_theta for each density truncation; fixed domination then proves both equations in the minimal envelope class for every smooth big real theta under BMP and positive lower minimal relative volume. Strict domination proves potential uniqueness for positive exponent and scalar uniqueness only at exponent zero. Volume addition, singularity monotonicity, and scaling correctly show that metric BMP and PVP imply the required positive lower minimal volume. The XL26 Theorems 5.2–5.3 attribution was confirmed against the [official v1 text](https://arxiv.org/html/2601.13446v1); its stronger metric assumptions and later Lemma 5.2 are not substituted for the submitted argument. No arbitrary-model existence is asserted. Full findings are persisted in memory/big_minimal_measures_01. No TeX or manuscript files were modified.
